name: list-mail-folders
description: Lists Outlook mail folders, including nested folders, with item, unread, and child-folder counts. complete: false means the list was cut short. Folder ids feed microsoft-outlook__search-messages and microsoft-outlook__move-message; well-known names inbox, sentitems, drafts, deleteditems, archive, and junkemail also work.

includeHidden.description: Include hidden mail folders. Defaults to false.
